svg.title: Paired and decoupled PI across the wall coupling
svg.desc: With Control Studio's designs frozen for an 8 kilowatt per degree wall, paired PI lets the unchanged vessel rise 0.218, 0.269 and 0.313 degrees Celsius at walls of 6, 8 and 10, always outside the 0.2 degree band. The decoupled group's dip shrinks from 0.223 to 0.170 degrees as the wall grows, outside the band at 6 and inside at 8 and 10, and under a 10 kilowatt load the other vessel falls 0.124 to 0.131 degrees, inside the band.
svg.text: Paired and decoupled PI across the wall coupling
Control Studio recordings · unchanged vessel 2 · designs of Lessons 71 and 72, frozen · walls of 6, 8 and 10 kW/°C · numbers answer the predictions
Decoupled: −0.223 °C at 6 fails; −0.194 at 8 and −0.170 at 10 kW/°C pass
